description: This file defines the GeofencingArgumentEntry class, which manages geofencing zone states within a larger system. It includes methods for updating, retrieving, and converting geofencing data, and implements interfaces for argument entries with timestamp handling.

classes.name: GeofencingArgumentEntry
classes.description: Manages geofencing zone states, supports updating, serialization, and timestamp retrieval, implementing ArgumentEntry and HasLatestTs interfaces.

methods.name: GeofencingArgumentEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing with an EntityId and AttributeValueProto.

methods.name: GeofencingArgumentEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a map of EntityId to KvEntry.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the argument entry type, GEOFENCING.

methods.name: getLatestTs
methods.description: Returns the maximum timestamp from zoneStates.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates the current entry with another ArgumentEntry, returning true if changes occurred.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if zoneStates is null or empty.

methods.name: toTbelCfArg
methods.description: Converts the object to a TbelCfGeofencingArg.

methods.name: toZones
methods.description: Converts a map of EntityId to KvEntry into zoneStates with GeofencingZoneState objects.

methods.name: updateZone
methods.description: Updates a specific zone's state, adding, removing, or updating as needed.
